# Error-budget policy: search

Owned by `discovery-team`. The runbook lives at <https://runbooks.example.com/search> and the dashboard at `/d/slo-search`.

## Objectives

| SLO | SLI | Objective | Window | Error budget | Budget as full outage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latency-p95` | share of requests served faster than the threshold | 95% | 28d | 5% | 2016 min |

Budget as full outage is the time the service could be completely down in one window and still meet the objective. It is a way to feel the size of the budget, not a permission to spend it in one go.

## Alerting

The alert is `SearchLatencyP95BudgetBurn`. Each page and ticket carries `severity`, `team`, `service` and `slo` labels, which is what the Alertmanager routing tree matches on.

| Severity | Burn rate | Long / short window | Budget spent when it fires | Routed to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page | 14.4x | 1h / 5m | 2.14% of 28d | `discovery-oncall` |
| page | 6x | 6h / 30m | 5.36% of 28d | `discovery-oncall` |
| ticket | 3x | 1d / 2h | 10.71% of 28d | `discovery-team` |
| ticket | 1x | 3d / 6h | 10.71% of 28d | `discovery-team` |

## What we do at each budget level

| Budget remaining | State | Release policy | Reliability work |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| above 50% | Healthy | Ship as usual | Normal backlog |
| 25% to 50% | Watch | Ship, with a rollback plan reviewed for risky changes | Owner reviews the top error sources weekly |
| 0% to 25% | Constrained | Only low-risk changes and fixes | At least one engineer on reliability items |
| exhausted | Frozen | Feature freeze, only fixes and security patches | Team priority until the budget is positive again |

## Escalation

1. A page alert opens an incident. The on-call engineer is incident commander until they hand it over.
2. A ticket alert is triaged within one working day and linked to the weekly reliability review.
3. If the budget is exhausted twice in a quarter, the owning team presents a reliability plan at the next service review.
4. Disagreements on a freeze go to the engineering manager of the owning team, who decides within two working days.

## Exceptions

Budget burned by a declared dependency outage or a planned maintenance window stays on the books, so the SLI keeps telling the truth. The freeze can be waived for it if the postmortem shows no action is needed on this service.
